## Quarto

Quarto enables you to weave together content and executable code into a finished document. To learn more about Quarto see <https://quarto.org>.

## Running Code

When you click the **Render** button a document will be generated that includes both content and the output of embedded code. You can embed code like this:

```{r}


knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = 'C:/Users/savan/OneDrive - San Francisco State University/ProjectData/GitHub/DepositionSFB/data')

elev_z_wind_slope_flux <- readr::read_csv(
  file.path(knitr::opts_knit$get("root.dir"), "elev_z_wind_slope_flux.csv")
)

rq3_model <- lmer(log(Flux) ~  z_star + local_slope + marsh_edge_type +
                    (1 | Site) , data = elev_z_wind_slope_flux)
```

You can add options to executable code like this

```{r, lasso regression}

#install.packages("glmnet")
library(glmnet)

lasso_data <- usgs_thesis %>%
  filter(Study.Dataset == "Thesis") %>%   
  select(Flux, z_star, local_slope, mean_wind_speed_kt, 
         max_gust_kt, Dist) %>%
  mutate(Dist = as.numeric(Dist)) %>%
  drop_na() %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.character), as.factor))
  

# standardize all numeric predictors (mean 0, SD 1) so coefficients are comparable
lasso_data_scaled <- lasso_data %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric) & !all_of("Flux"), ~ as.numeric(scale(.))))

x_scaled <- model.matrix(Flux ~ . - 1, data = lasso_data_scaled)
y <- lasso_data_scaled$Flux

set.seed(42)
cv_lasso_scaled <- cv.glmnet(x_scaled, y, alpha = 1)
plot(cv_lasso_scaled)

best_lambda_scaled <- cv_lasso_scaled$lambda.min
lasso_final_scaled <- glmnet(x_scaled, y, alpha = 1, lambda = best_lambda_scaled)
coef(lasso_final_scaled)
```

```{r}

library(ggplot2)

ggplot(elev_z_wind_slope_flux_clean, aes(x = mean_wind_speed_kt, y = Flux, color = Tran)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.4) +
  facet_wrap(~ Site) +
  labs(
    title = "Flux vs. Mean Wind Speed by Site and Transect",
    x = "Mean Wind Speed (kt)", y = "Flux", color = "Transect"
  ) +
  theme_bw()
```

```{r}

library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

# Flux vs. Wind, excluding Giant Marsh
ggplot(elev_z_wind_slope_flux_clean %>% filter(Site != "GiantMarsh"), 
       aes(x = mean_wind_speed_kt, y = Flux, color = Tran)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.4) +
  facet_wrap(~ Site) +
  labs(
    title = "Flux vs. Mean Wind Speed by Site and Transect (Excluding Giant Marsh)",
    x = "Mean Wind Speed (kt)", y = "Flux", color = "Transect"
  ) +
  theme_bw()

# Flux vs. Slope, excluding Giant Marsh
ggplot(elev_z_wind_slope_flux_clean %>% filter(Site != "GiantMarsh"), 
       aes(x = local_slope, y = Flux, color = Tran)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.4) +
  facet_wrap(~ Site) +
  labs(
    title = "Flux vs. Local Slope by Site and Transect (Excluding Giant Marsh)",
    x = "Local Slope", y = "Flux", color = "Transect"
  ) +
  theme_bw()
```
